## Type of change

- [ ] New effect or pattern
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (tab, capability)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with no new errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] New effects/patterns checked against the existing registry for id
      collisions and conceptual overlap (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] If this touches a video-eligible effect that uses `rng()` for a
      one-time style choice (not a per-frame glitch decision), it's
      tagged `stableAcrossFrames: true`
- [ ] If this fixes a bug, a regression test for it is included
- [ ] Every changed/new file is under 200 lines (or the PR explains why
      it couldn't reasonably be split further)
- [ ] No new dependencies added without prior discussion in an issue
